back.en: Growth, repair of damaged tissue, replacing old cells, reproduction
back.bm: Pertumbuhan, membaiki tisu rosak, menggantikan sel lama, pembiakan

back.en: A matching pair, one from each parent, same size and genes
back.bm: Sepasang kromosom sepadan, satu dari setiap induk, saiz dan gen sama

back.en: G1 (growth), S (DNA replication), G2 (prepare to divide) — the longest phase
back.bm: G1 (pertumbuhan), S (replikasi DNA), G2 (bersedia membahagi) — fasa paling lama

back.en: Chromosomes condense and become visible; nuclear membrane breaks down; spindle forms
back.bm: Kromosom memendek dan kelihatan; membran nukleus hilang; gelendong terbentuk

back.en: Metaphase: line up at equator. Anaphase: sister chromatids pulled to opposite poles
back.bm: Metafasa: tersusun di khatulistiwa. Anafasa: kromatid beradik ditarik ke kutub bertentangan

back.en: Two nuclei form; cytoplasm divides (cleavage furrow in animals, cell plate in plants)
back.bm: Dua nukleus terbentuk; sitoplasma membahagi (alur pembelahan dalam haiwan, plat sel dalam tumbuhan)

back.en: Tissue culture (oil palm, orchids), cloning, stem cell research
back.bm: Kultur tisu (kelapa sawit, orkid), pengklonan, penyelidikan sel stem

back.en: Crossing over in prophase I; homologous chromosomes separate → 2 haploid cells
back.bm: Pindah silang dalam profasa I; kromosom homolog berpisah → 2 sel haploid

back.en: Sister chromatids separate → 4 genetically different haploid cells
back.bm: Kromatid beradik berpisah → 4 sel haploid berbeza secara genetik

back.en: Uncontrolled mitosis → tumour; causes: carcinogens, radiation, UV, some viruses
back.bm: Mitosis tidak terkawal → tumor; punca: karsinogen, sinaran, UV, sesetengah virus
